title: Submission-fixture comment claims 'never rented skips eviction' but the fixture submits never_rented_before="false" (rented before) and answers the eviction question
evidence:
+  // Minimum valid submission (student → no employer fields; never rented
+  // skips eviction). Mirrors the gdpr integration fixture.
...
+    #("never_rented_before", "false"),
+    #("has_eviction_history", "no"),
detail: With "false" the applicant HAS rented, so eviction history applies — and the fixture indeed answers it ("no") plus the landlord-ref fields. The comment describes the opposite branch (never-rented skipping eviction). The test still passes; the comment misleads about which validation branch the fixture exercises.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to match the fixture (rented before, eviction answered), or flip the value to the never-rented branch if that was the intended minimal path.
